services.name: Samaritans of Singapore (SOS)

services.name: National mindline 1771
services.desc: National 24/7 mental health line for distress or crisis. Call, text or chat, and get linked to further care.

services.name: IMH Emergency Services

services.name: Emergency services
services.desc: Ambulance 995 for medical emergencies or imminent risk to life. Police 999 for immediate danger.

services.name: SAMH Helpline
services.desc: Counselling, community mental health and recovery services for adults and youth.

services.name: Silver Ribbon (Singapore)
services.desc: Mental health literacy, anti-stigma work and counselling support.

services.name: Care Corner Counselling Helpline
services.desc: Counselling helpline, with support for Mandarin speakers. 10am to 10pm.

services.name: CHAT
services.desc: Mental health check-ins and assessment for young people aged 16 to 30.

services.name: All Addictions Helpline
services.desc: Assessment and treatment for drug, alcohol, gambling, gaming and other addictions. Helpline 8am to 11pm daily.

services.name: National Problem Gambling Helpline
services.desc: Help for people with gambling problems and their families, including information on exclusion orders.

services.name: Alcoholics Anonymous Singapore
services.desc: Peer support groups for people who want to stop drinking.

services.name: Singapore Anti-Narcotics Association (SANA)
services.desc: Aftercare, counselling and reintegration support for people recovering from drug use, and their families.

services.name: Sexual Assault Care Centre (SACC)

services.name: National Anti-Violence and Sexual Harassment Helpline
services.org: Ministry of Social and Family Development
services.desc: 24-hour helpline to report or get help for family violence, sexual violence, and harassment.

services.name: AWARE Women's Care Centre Helpline
services.desc: Helpline, counselling and legal clinic for women facing abuse or discrimination. Weekdays 10am to 6pm.

services.name: PAVe
services.org: Centre for Promoting Alternatives to Violence
services.desc: Family violence specialist centre offering counselling for survivors, children and people who use violence.

services.name: ComCare Hotline

services.desc: Financial assistance for low-income households and links to the nearest Social Service Office or Family Service Centre.

services.name: Credit Counselling Singapore
services.desc: Free debt counselling and debt management programmes for individuals with unsecured debt.

services.name: Family Service Centres

services.desc: Neighbourhood centres for casework, counselling and coordinated help for families. Find the nearest one through ComCare or MSF.

services.name: SupportGoWhere
services.desc: Searchable list of government support schemes and services with an eligibility checker.

services.name: BABES Pregnancy Crisis Support
services.desc: Support for teenagers and young women facing unplanned pregnancy.

services.name: Pregnancy Crisis Service
services.desc: Counselling and practical support for women in crisis pregnancy.

services.name: TOUCHline
services.desc: Counselling helpline for youth and their parents.

services.name: Tinkle Friend
services.desc: Helpline and chat for primary-school-aged children who feel lonely, worried or unsafe.

services.name: Agency for Integrated Care
services.desc: Care options and caregiver support for seniors, including home care, day care and respite.

services.name: Seniors Helpline
services.desc: Counselling and information helpline for seniors and their caregivers.

services.name: SG Enable
services.desc: First stop for disability services, schemes, employment support and assistive tech.

services.name: Migrant Workers' Centre
services.desc: Help for migrant workers with employment disputes, welfare and emergencies.

services.name: HOME
services.desc: Shelter, legal and welfare support for migrant workers, including domestic workers facing abuse.

services.name: MOM Helpline
services.desc: Employment and work pass enquiries. Weekdays 8.30am to 5.30pm.

services.name: Legal Aid Bureau
services.desc: Civil legal aid, including divorce, custody and maintenance, for people who meet the means test.

services.name: Pro Bono SG
services.desc: Free legal clinics and help for people who can't afford a lawyer.

services.desc: How to apply for a PPO or Expedited Order against family violence.
